asked.item: Credits used by posting your own photos

verdict.reason: The help pages say scheduling and publishing use no credits, and uploading your own image uses none.

steps.text: Credits are not used for scheduling posts or publishing posts.
quotes: Credits are NOT used for scheduling posts, publishing posts, or AI voiceovers.

steps.text: Uploading your own image does not use credits, and AI credits are used only when you generate AI images and AI videos.
quotes: Uploading your own image and drafting text do not.
In Blotato, AI credits are consumed when you generate AI images and AI videos.
